create_mistral3_config: create a Mistral3Config instance with default vision and text configs for a multimodal model
build_mistral3_config_from_dicts: build a Mistral3Config from dict-based vision_config and text_config that auto-resolves to Pixtral and Mistral configs
initialize_mistral3_vision_config: initialize the default Pixtral vision config with 1024 hidden size and 24 layers when vision_config is None
configure_mistral3_text_model: configure the default Mistral text model with 5120 hidden size, 40 layers, and 131072 max position embeddings
access_mistral3_image_token_id: access the Mistral3Config attribute_map that maps image_token_id to image_token_index
